## DeskHelper Pro 1.3.4
**Improvements** - **Pointer & Scroll** — the Pointer and Scroll panels now stay in sync with the mouse you're actually using. Moving or scrolling with a device highlights it in both panels, so per-device settings reliably apply to the right mouse, including when a virtual input device (such as Karabiner) is in the pipeline. - **Permissions** — the permissions overview groups each permission by how essential it is and explains which feature it enables, so it's clearer what to grant and why.
